keyword: where is world baseball classic being played

verifications.claim: The 2026 World Baseball Classic is being played across four main locations.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The 2026 World Baseball Classic will be held at four different venues – Tokyo Dome in Japan, Hiram Bithorn Stadium in Puerto Rico, Daikin Park in Houston and LoanDepot Park in Miami.'; R2: 'pools -- located at Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan, Puerto Rico; Daikin Park in Houston; and loanDepot park in Miami'; R4: 'staged in Tokyo, San Juan, Houston and Miami'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state four main venues/locations for the tournament.

verifications.claim: The final rounds of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are hosted at loanDepot park in Miami, Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Miami will host the World Baseball Classic semifinals and final'; R3: 'Semi-Finals and Championship will be held from March 15-17'; R4: 'Semi-finals 15 March... Final 17 March... @LoanDepot Park'
verifications.reasoning: Semifinals and final (final rounds) are clearly at loanDepot park, Miami.

verifications.claim: The 2026 World Baseball Classic runs from March 5-17, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: schedules from March 4-17 (ET); R2: 'begin on March 5... championship... March 17'; R4: 'from 5-17 March'

verifications.claim: The 2026 World Baseball Classic features 20 teams.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'rosters for the 20 teams'; R6: 'between 20 national baseball teams'

verifications.claim: Pool play of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is held at loanDepot park in Miami, Florida.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4/R6: Pool D pool play at loanDepot, but Pools A/B/C at other venues (Hiram Bithorn, Daikin Park, Tokyo Dome).
verifications.reasoning: Pool play occurs at four venues, not solely or primarily at loanDepot; claim implies it is held there (exclusively).

verifications.claim: Pool play of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is held at Daikin Park in Houston, Texas.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4/R6: Pool B pool play at Daikin Park, but other pools at different venues.
verifications.reasoning: Pool play split across four venues; claim misattributes as held at Daikin Park.

verifications.claim: Pool play of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is held at Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4/R6: Pool C pool play at Tokyo Dome, but others elsewhere.
verifications.reasoning: Only one pool's play at Tokyo Dome; claim incorrect for overall pool play.

verifications.claim: Pool play of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is held at Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan, Puerto Rico.

verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4/R6: Pool A at Hiram Bithorn, others at different venues.
verifications.reasoning: Pool play across four sites; claim falsely specifies one venue.

verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: QF2/QF3 at Daikin Park Houston, QF1/QF4 at loanDepot Miami; R4/R6 confirm split.
verifications.reasoning: Only two of four quarterfinals at Daikin Park; claim implies all.
